body: Craig Dennis had never drawn an SVG by hand or used Blender. With the SVG & 3D Design plugin for Codex, he shows how to turn a reference image into an editable graphic or 3D model, then ask for changes in plain language. See how a small change in SVG code can make a character’s eyes follow your cursor, and how Codex uses Blender to check a model from another angle. Enable SVG & 3D Design in Codex and tell us what you build!
